description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Cater], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode
description.text: Keeps track of TP level (0~6), increases TP level by 1 when the character is hit by a damaging attack or an ally uses a damaging action, casts a certain ability when TP level reaches 6. Removed after 8 abilities.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode: Cater
description.text: Fire/Ice/Lightning abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, penetrate 20% DEF and RES; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single attack (11.00 each) capped at 199,999, ranged. Grants [Fire, Ice, Lightning Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Fire, Ice, Lightning DEF and RES 40% Piercing (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, causes [Deprotect 20% (15s)] to all enemies if any target has at least 30% Imperil Fire, Ice, or Lightning, causes [Imperil Fire 30% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 30% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 30% (15s)] to all enemies if not
